headline: Solid chest-high SSE swell, glassy morning then the sea breeze takes over.
today: Morning is the play — 2-3ft at a good angle with light N winds keeping it clean off the incoming tide. Afternoon ESE cross-onshore texture moves in, so surf it before midday. Fish or groveler; enough size to have fun on most boards.

daysToWatch.note: Only 2ft but it's a rare prime angle for Lido and dawn winds are light — dawn patrol on a log before the SSE onshore fills in by afternoon. Small but clean.
Waist-to-chest but short period and cross winds building all day. Workable early, deteriorates.
